routes.label: in person at the Electoral and Boundaries Commission

note: The Attorney General, as Barbados Today reported (15 June 2023): the Barbados Identity Management Act makes the first issue free (section 10) and a replacement BBD 60 (section 13, not modelled). The card's term, the age from which it is issued and the time aren't in the report, and the government's information service refused this session, so they're left open: the card is offered at any age with its term unknown.

sources.title: Barbados Today, AG assures no cost for first Trident ID (15 June 2023)
sources.said: This stance runs throughout the Barbados Identity Management Act which sets out in clear terms in Section 10 that the first issue of an ID card is free of charge. Replacement cards are dealt with by Section 13 of the Act which provides that where the new ID card is to be replaced, that there is a $60 fee.
